style="font-size:13px">Request path · a preview from PR to results</font></b><br><br><div style="line-height:1.6"><span style="background-color:#f8fafc;color:#020617;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">1</span> A maintainer (or an agent) opens a same-repo PR in Provisioning, Mods or Proxy and adds the preview label.<br><span style="background-color:#f8fafc;color:#020617;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">2</span> CI builds an immutable bundle (regenerated index.json, built jars) to Garage previews/&lt;repo&gt;-pr&lt;n&gt;/&lt;sha&gt;/.<br><span style="background-color:#f8fafc;color:#020617;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">3</span> The ApplicationSet PR generator polls GitHub (every 180 s or a webhook) and makes one Application per PR.<br><span style="background-color:#f8fafc;color:#020617;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">4</span> Argo CD syncs it in project arffornia-preview to ns arffornia-pr-&lt;repo&gt;-&lt;n&gt;, PSA restricted.<br><span style="background-color:#f8fafc;color:#020617;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">5</span> The config-updater pulls the bundle instead of main: BASE_URL is the only change.<br><span style="background-color:#f8fafc;color:#020617;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">6</span> The server uses its own 1-instance Zalando Postgres; credentials stay in the namespace, no Vault.<br><span style="background-color:#f8fafc;color:#020617;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">7</span> A post-sync Job waits for Done, runs rcon-cli tests (/forge mods, /gametest runall), greps logs.<br><span style="background-color:#f8fafc;color:#020617;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">8</span> It posts a JUnit summary and logs as a PR comment. Closing the PR deletes the namespace.</div></span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="330" width="900" x="770" y="1440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card-guardrails" parent="1" style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=16;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#0b1222;strokeColor=#1e293b;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=20;spacingTop=14;spacingRight=16;fontFamily=JetBrains Mono,Noto Sans Mono,DejaVu Sans Mono,monospace;fontSize=11;fontColor=#e2e8f0;" value="<span style="font-variant-ligatures:none"><font color="#fb7185">●</font>&nbsp;<b><font color="#f8fafc" style="font-size:13px">Guardrails</font></b><br><br><div style="line-height:1.6">• AppProject arffornia-preview: destinations arffornia-pr-* only; VaultSecret, PV, LoadBalancer and cluster-scoped kinds denied.<br>• ResourceQuota 8 GiB / 3 CPU and a LimitRange per preview; a cap on concurrent previews.<br>• Default-deny NetworkPolicy: egress to the internet (mod CDNs) and its own DB only; no cluster CIDRs, no 192.168.1.0/24.<br>• automountServiceAccountToken: false. Never on fork PRs: a PR jar is arbitrary Java.<br>• Access: mc-router behind one MetalLB IP, pr-&lt;n&gt;.preview.arffornia.com on LAN/VPN; offline-mode off, whitelist on.</div></span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="330" width="640" x="1700" y="1440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card-open" parent="1" style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=16;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#0b1222;strokeColor=#1e293b;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=20;spacingTop=14;spacingRight=16;fontFamily=JetBrains Mono,Noto Sans Mono,DejaVu Sans Mono,monospace;fontSize=11;fontColor=#e2e8f0;" value="<span style="font-variant-ligatures:none"><font color="#fb923c">●</font>&nbsp;<b><font color="#f8fafc" style="font-size:13px">Open questions</font></b><br><br><div style="line-height:1.6">• Q1 Capacity: a 300-mod pack needs 8-16 GiB per server; node headroom is unknown.<br>• Q2 Website API for previews: stub, shared staging or per-PR instance.<br>• Q3 Release channels: keep main as production, or add a stable tag and treat main as staging.<br>• Prerequisite: per-namespace Vault roles (G4), or previews could read every Arffornia secret.</div></span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="330" width="490" x="2370" y="1440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

Out of scope: the local arffornia-server Helm chart and the Nexus_Mods `url` source and overrides.json it needs (prerequisites, not runtime) · a preview website (open question Q2: stub, shared staging, or per-PR)

b.span: Request path · a preview from PR to results

span.div:
1 A maintainer (or an agent) opens a same-repo PR in Provisioning, Mods or Proxy and adds the preview label.
2 CI builds an immutable bundle (regenerated index.json, built jars) to Garage previews/<repo>-pr<n>/<sha>/.
3 The ApplicationSet PR generator polls GitHub (every 180 s or a webhook) and makes one Application per PR.
4 Argo CD syncs it in project arffornia-preview to ns arffornia-pr-<repo>-<n>, PSA restricted.
5 The config-updater pulls the bundle instead of main: BASE_URL is the only change.
6 The server uses its own 1-instance Zalando Postgres; credentials stay in the namespace, no Vault.
7 A post-sync Job waits for Done, runs rcon-cli tests (/forge mods, /gametest runall), greps logs.
8 It posts a JUnit summary and logs as a PR comment. Closing the PR deletes the namespace.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(11, 18, 34), rgb(217, 223, 237)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(30, 41, 59), rgb(195, 204, 220));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 602px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1461px; margin-left: 1722px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #e2e8f0;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Noto Sans Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace; color: light-dark(#e2e8f0, #22272e); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

span.div:
• AppProject arffornia-preview: destinations arffornia-pr-* only; VaultSecret, PV, LoadBalancer and cluster-scoped kinds denied.
• ResourceQuota 8 GiB / 3 CPU and a LimitRange per preview; a cap on concurrent previews.
• Default-deny NetworkPolicy: egress to the internet (mod CDNs) and its own DB only; no cluster CIDRs, no 192.168.1.0/24.
• automountServiceAccountToken: false. Never on fork PRs: a PR jar is arbitrary Java.
• Access: mc-router behind one MetalLB IP, pr-<n>.preview.arffornia.com on LAN/VPN; offline-mode off, whitelist on.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(11, 18, 34), rgb(217, 223, 237)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(30, 41, 59), rgb(195, 204, 220));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 452px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1461px; margin-left: 2392px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #e2e8f0;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Noto Sans Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace; color: light-dark(#e2e8f0, #22272e); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

span.div:
• Q1 Capacity: a 300-mod pack needs 8-16 GiB per server; node headroom is unknown.
• Q2 Website API for previews: stub, shared staging or per-PR instance.
• Q3 Release channels: keep main as production, or add a stable tag and treat main as staging.
• Prerequisite: per-namespace Vault roles (G4), or previews could read every Arffornia secret.
